programmes.d: Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there and has several members suspected in a series of bombings.
When a Muslim college student and his younger brother are murdered, the team connects with the outraged imam of OA's former mosque, who insists the victims were wrongly targeted as terrorists.
The team rushes to investigate an extremist gun group after an anti-gun lobbyist building is bombed, with the promise of others to follow.

The team realizes they have a cross-country serial killer on their hands, after another body is found bound with the same knot as their local victim. Also, the case has ties to Isobel's father, Robert, leading to revelations about their relationship.
When Raines' sister goes missing in Kosovo, he goes rogue to find her, putting his job and his life on the line. Also, Kellett and Forrester face further scrutiny from inside the Bureau.
The Fly Team lands in hot water when Vo is found at the scene where a Hungarian gambling regulator was murdered.
When an American vintner is shot and killed on his wine estate in France, the Fly Team must determine if the region's local protest group with a history of violence against foreigners is to blame.

Following a frenzied attack by gunmen aboard an American-owned river cruise ship on the Danube, the Fly Team heads to Vienna to investigate why the boat was targeted. Also, Forrester realizes his feelings of mistrust are affecting personal relationships.

The Fly Team works to hunt down the sniper responsible for killing an American during an attack targeting a biomedical lab in Belgium. Also, Jaeger clashes with her boss at Europol over her allegiance to the Fly Team.
As the team searches for an abducted college co-ed,Jubal becomes intent on obtaining lifesaving leads from the father of the abductor's previous victim.
